name: Steel Authority of India Ltd.
about: Steel Authority of India Limited, a steel-making company, manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company offers a range of railway products, which include rail, high YS/UTS rail, corrosion-resistant micro-alloyed rail, vanadium alloyed rail, end forged thick web asymmetric rail, conductivity rail, crane rails, and crossing sleeper bars. It also provides pig iron, cold rolled products, pipes, semis, structurals, sail tmt bars, galvanized products, wirerods, pm plates, railway products, wheels and axles, hot rolled products, stainless steel products, electrical steels, and sail SeQR TMT bars. It serves government organizations, PSUS, private companies, distributors, and resellers. Steel Authority of India Limited was founded in 1954 and is based in New Delhi, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~19% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~2% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 14.0% cost of equity).
PE of 12 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 21), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 12 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 19 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 31% a year while PE moved 16 → 12.
